Research and analysis

Environmental monitoring following the Grenfell Tower fire

Air quality reports for the survivors and residents of the area surrounding Grenfell Tower.

From:
UK Health Security Agency
Published:
14 July 2017
Last updated:
28 August 2026 — See all updates

Documents

Environmental monitoring following the Grenfell Tower fire: 27 August 2026

PDF, 3.33 MB, 30 pages

Environmental monitoring following the Grenfell Tower fire: 29 December 2021 report (including all monitoring data to that date)

Ref: UKHSA publications gateway number GOV-10932

PDF, 14 MB

This file may not be suitable for users of assistive technology.

Request an accessible format.
If you use assistive technology (such as a screen reader) and need a version of this document in a more accessible format, please email publications@ukhsa.gov.uk. Please tell us what format you need. It will help us if you say what assistive technology you use.

Details

This is a regular weekly report about the air quality in the area surrounding Grenfell Tower. It contains data tables, graphs, an explanation of the data and photos of monitoring equipment.

The report covers the last 4 weeks of results and environmental monitoring data is shown alongside an explanation of the data in terms of potential impacts on health.

For all monitoring results between 24 June 2017 and 29 December 2021, see the ‘Environmental monitoring following the Grenfell Tower fire report’ dated 29 December 2021.
